title: An operator can rescope a sprint's goal, and close --summary maps clauses to the sprint's own items
goal: A sprint's goal changes only by the operator (set SP --goal G --by operator, refused without it), so a rescope that a gate answers lands in the goal close --summary reads, not only in notes; move --sprint none out of a planned sprint prints the goal clause the item leaves behind and names that remedy (SP-vayhvwfy: a clause of a moved-out item stayed in the goal and close --summary listed it unmet); and close --summary names an open item outside the sprint beside an unmet clause only as gate g2's answer says (a similar open item outside the sprint, two or more shared words), never as its carrier, so a one-word clause such as 'passing' is no longer matched to another sprint's item (SP-eahtellz: 'passing' was shown as carried by ST-e5u5zhrc of SP-matmvkn6). goal_clause_lines already credits a clause only to a done item of the sprint itself; the fallback 'unmet, carried by <open item elsewhere>' (bl_land.py, a 50% word match) is what changes.

run: import subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,os,json,shutil;t=tempfile.mkdtemp();s.run(['git','init','-q',t],check=True);os.makedirs(t+'/kb/_self/backlog');b=[sys.executable,os.getcwd()+'/_tools/backlog.py','--root',t];run=lambda *a:s.run(b+list(a),capture_output=True,text=True,cwd=t);sp=run('new','sprint','--title','S','--goal','old goal clause').stdout.split()[2];goal=lambda:json.load(open(f'{t}/_backlog/{sp}.json',encoding='utf-8-sig')).get('goal');a=run('set',sp,'--goal','rescoped goal clause');ga=goal();b2=run('set',sp,'--goal','rescoped goal clause','--by','operator');gb=goal();shutil.rmtree(t,ignore_errors=True);print('no --by: exit',a.returncode,'goal',repr(ga),'| --by operator: exit',b2.returncode,'goal',repr(gb),(b2.stderr or b2.stdout).strip()[:100]);sys.exit(0 if a.returncode!=0 and ga=='old goal clause' and b2.returncode==0 and gb=='rescoped goal clause' else 1)

import sys,types
sys.path.insert(0,"_tools")
import bl_land
it={"SP-a":{"kind":"sprint","goal":"the alpha reader works; checks stay passing stable"},
    "ST-1":{"kind":"story","status":"done","title":"Alpha reader","goal":"the alpha reader works"},
    "ST-2":{"kind":"story","status":"todo","title":"Checks passing","goal":"make passing stable"}}
bl=types.SimpleNamespace(items=it,label=lambda i:i)
out=bl_land.goal_clause_lines(bl,"SP-a",["ST-1"])

import subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,os,shutil
t=tempfile.mkdtemp()
s.run(["git","init","-q",t],check=True)
os.makedirs(t+"/kb/_self/backlog")
b=[sys.executable,os.getcwd()+"/_tools/backlog.py","--root",t]
run=lambda *a:s.run(b+list(a),capture_output=True,text=True,cwd=t)
sp=run("new","sprint","--title","S","--goal","the alpha reader works; the beta writer works").stdout.split()[2]
st=run("new","story","--title","Beta writer","--sprint",sp,"--goal","the beta writer works","--check","python3 -c 1/0").stdout.split()[2]
r=run("move",st,"--sprint","none")
out=r.stdout+r.stderr
shutil.rmtree(t,ignore_errors=True)
print("move exit",r.returncode,out.strip()[:300])
sys.exit(0 if r.returncode==0 and "beta writer works" in out and "set "+sp+" --goal" in out and "--by operator" in out else 1)

gates.question: When set changes a planned sprint's goal after its start gate was approved, does the approval stand?
options: the start gate is reopened for a new answer
set refuses a goal change on an approved sprint

gates.question: How does close --summary name an open item outside the sprint whose words match an unmet clause?
options: only with two or more shared words, labelled similar open item outside the sprint
gates.recommendation: only with two or more shared words, labelled similar open item outside the sprint
gates.answer: only with two or more shared words, labelled similar open item outside the sprint

gates.question: Does move print the goal clause an item leaves behind for every move out of a sprint (planned or active, to none or to another sprint), or only for --sprint none out of a planned sprint?
options: every move out of a sprint
only --sprint none out of a planned sprint
gates.recommendation: every move out of a sprint

notes: Premise (2026-10-10, run): goal_clause_lines for the sprint goal 'the alpha reader works; passing' prints '2. passing: unmet, carried by ST-2' for an open item elsewhere (the second check prints it), and bl_items.py:472 refuses set --goal on a sprint ('a sprint takes notes, links and delegates only'); move --sprint none prints only 'moved ... to no sprint' (the fourth check prints it). The first check plants a --root repo, so it does not break when a live sprint closes. The third and fourth checks read the wording 'similar open item outside the sprint' and 'set SP-... --goal ... --by operator': rename in the check if the work words them otherwise. Merged from ST-27vxkvm6 at the 2026-10-10 backlog triage (its goal is folded into this goal): move --sprint none out of a planned sprint prints the clause left behind and names set SP --goal G --by operator.
